q1_issues.issue: The antecedent is written with constant witnesses (sk_hold_1, sk_store_1) that are asserted nowhere, so the implication can never match a stored holding event or feather store; the rule forms elsewhere bind an antecedent event and an antecedent indefinite with $-variables and keep only specific definite referents (here 'watch') as constants.

q2_gaps: continuative copula 'stay / remain / keep + ADJ' ('stays safe') — no operator or tag is defined for it (the opaque Still tag is for the adverb 'still' on an eventuality, not for a copular verb), so the persistence meaning has no carrier and is dropped

an indicative conditional with an indefinite in its antecedent — the Counterfactual section routes 'if X, Y' to 'a plain Implication rule' but never says which antecedent constituents become $-variables and which stay witness constants
notes: 'the Watch' as a name symbol with no kind atom is right since the text supplies no kind word, and 'Sunken Cove' correctly takes its Name plus (Member sunken_cove cove) with no 'sunken' modifier atom. Holder for 'holds' reads it as possession, though the instruction set's only worked 'hold' example ('the tank holds forty litres') is a stative transitive that keeps Agent.
